title: The Gym Where You See TOMORROW 💪
description:
At Big Wendell's gym, the mirror shows you tomorrow. People check it before they sign for a house or quit a job, and tomorrow-you never lies.

My best friend asked for my savings tonight. So I looked, and tomorrow-me told me what to do. Then he told me again.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment 1 or 2. Which me would you believe?
